description: Buy or sell a prediction outcome with a fill-or-kill market order (fills entirely at a protected price or nothing happens). BUY: amount_usd (min $1; Polymarket's taker fee and our builder fee go on top — the same everyone pays; max_spend_usd caps the all-in spend). SELL: shares. Optional limit_price (BUY: max, SELL: min) — the house price guard still applies, the stricter wins. Returns typed_data: sign it with your AGENT wallet (EIP-712), then submit_prediction_order within 60s. Your caps (order size, account exposure, daily loss) count perps and predictions together; sells only reduce and skip them.

amount_usd.description: BUY only: USD to spend (min $1; fees go on top)

client_order_id.description: Your own id for this order (up to 64 characters)

limit_price.description: Optional worst price as a probability 0–1 (buy: max, sell: min); it can only tighten the house guard

max_spend_usd.description: BUY only: cap on the all-in spend, fees included

shares.description: SELL only: how many shares to sell

side.description: buy = buy shares of this outcome; sell = sell shares you hold

token_id.description: The outcome's CLOB token id (decimal string) from list_prediction_markets

name: place_prediction_order
